entry.title: About Tiered Client Resource Downloads
entry.content:
Dear Rovers, To deliver a higher-quality gaming experience across a wide range of device specifications, the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature is scheduled to be launched soon on Wuthering Waves, initially as a limited test. This feature allows you to select and download game resources of your preferred graphics quality based on the storage space and specifications of your device. With this feature, you can reduce storage space usage while maintaining satisfactory graphics quality.

Feature Overview

What is Tiered Client Resource Downloads?

Tiered Client Resource Downloads is a feature that allows you to select between different resource tiers. In future versions of Wuthering Waves, the original single resource package will be divided into three tiers based on differences in graphics quality, models, and other game assets: UHD, HD, and SD. You may select and download the tier that best suits the storage space and specifications of your device.

This feature is designed to allow you to choose better graphics quality or lower storage space usage based on your actual gaming needs, thereby providing a better gaming experience.

Tier Specifications

Tiered Client Resource Downloads will be available for the PC, iOS, and Android versions of the game. The package tiers vary in in-game graphics quality, video bitrate, and other game assets. Supported platforms and tiers are outlined below:

| | | |

| --- | --- | --- |

| Platform | Available Tiers | Maximum Number of Local Packages |

| PC | UHD/HD/SD | Up to 3 packages (tiers) installed locally |

| iOS/Android | HD/SD | Up to 1 package (tier) installed locally |

Due to platform restrictions, platforms not listed above currently do not support resource tiering. Once this feature goes live, the HD package will be downloaded by default on those platforms.

Due to hardware limitations, only the SD package is available on certain mobile devices, in order to ensure a stable, smooth gaming experience. Please refer to your actual in-game experience.

Package Downloading & Switching

  • PC：

Download your desired tier or tiers directly from the launcher. You can install up to 3 different tiers locally and switch between them any time. If you have multiple tiers installed, to run the game, simply choose one tier from the launcher to launch (only one can run at a time). If you need to uninstall a specific tier, select the corresponding package before uninstalling.

  • iOS / Android:

Select your desired package tier from the in-game "Download Resources" menu. Once the download is complete, you can redownload and switch to another tier via Settings > Graphics > Resource Quality.

On mobile devices, every switch between packages requires downloading the difference between the HD and SD packages.

Test Schedule

  • Test Participants and Test Schedule

  • PC (※Official Launcher): The test will become gradually available on PC after the Version 3.7 update.

  • iOS/Android Mobile: The test will become available on all iOS/Android mobile devices after the Version 3.7 update.

  • Notes

  • We will soon (during Version 3.6) make a PC launcher update available to some of the Rovers who are granted access to the limited test. However, the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature will only go live after the Version 3.7 update. During Version 3.6, being granted access to the limited test will not affect your current gaming experience.

  • Following the Version 3.7 update, PC users who have not been granted access to the limited test will have their resource package updated to the High-Definition (HD) version by default. Once you enter the test, you can adjust the resource tier based on your needs.

The feature will also be gradually made available on PC platforms with non-official launchers after the test concludes. Please stay tuned for future announcements.

Notes & Reminders

About Version 3.7 Pre-download

  • PC (※Official Launcher):

  • For Rovers who are granted access to the limited test and update the official launcher during Version 3.6, Version 3.7 pre-download will be temporarily unavailable due to cross-version functionality differences. You may select and download a suitable resource tier after the Version 3.7 update.

  • For Rovers who do not gain access to the limited test during Version 3.6, pre-download will remain available, and if they use the pre-download feature, the HD resource tier will be downloaded by default. After gaining test access in Version 3.7, you can then choose a resource tier based on your needs.

  • iOS/Android Mobile:

  • Once Version 3.7 pre-download becomes available, only a portion of the resources will be pre-downloaded on iOS and Android mobile devices. The remaining tiered resources will be downloaded separately after the Version 3.7 update, based on the package selected.

The Pre-download feature from Version 3.7 onward will function as usual, and the pre-downloaded resources will be of the same tier as your currently selected resources.

How to Choose a Package Tier

After the Version 3.7 update, if you have been included in the limited test, the recommended package will be marked on your device based on the device specifications. Alternatively, you can refer to the following specs table to select the right package.

  • PC

| | | | | |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| CPU | GPU | Recommended RAM | Recommended Resolution | Recommended Package |

| Intel i7-12700/AMD R7 7700 | RTX4080/RX 7900 XT | 32G | 3840X2160 | UHD |

| Intel i7-9700/AMD R7 3700X | RTX3060/RX6700XT/Arc B580 | 32G | 2560X1440 | HD |

| Intel i5-9400/AMD R7 2700 | GTX 1060/RX 570/Arc A380 | 16G | 1920X1080 | SD |

  • iOS

| | | | |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Model | Chip | RAM | Recommended Package |

| iPhone14/iPad mini (6th generation) | A15 | 6G | HD |

| iPhone11/iPad (9th generation) | A13 | 4G | SD |

  • Android

| | | |

| --- | --- | --- |

| Chipset | RAM | Recommended Package |

| Snapdragon 8 Gen1/MediaTek Dimensity 9000/Kirin 9010/Exynos 2200 | 8G | HD |

| Snapdragon 855/MediaTek Dimensity 1000/Kirin 980/Exynos 9820 | 6G | SD |

About In-Game Resource Adjustments

  • Graphics Resource Adjustments

After the release of the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature, the Ultra Quality option in the in-game Graphics Quality settings will be available only in the UHD package. Therefore, after Version 3.7 goes live, if you are not in the limited test, you will temporarily be unable to enable the Ultra Graphics option on PC. To enable this option, you need to download the UHD package first after entering the test.

  • Video Resource Adjustments

After the release of the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature, bitrates of certain cutscenes and other video assets will be adjusted accordingly; consequently, visual fidelity may differ between packages.

Following the Version 3.7 update, because PC users who have not been granted access to the limited test will download the HD package by default, the visual performance of certain video resources may be somewhat different from the previous versions. When you are granted test access, you can download the UHD package for higher bitrates.

  • Future Resource Adjustments

The upcoming "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature is currently under continuous optimization. In the future, we may adjust the resources included in each tier based on in-game performance and player feedback. The adjusted resources may differ slightly from those in the current test version. Announcements about adjustments in this regard will be made during the corresponding versions. Please stay tuned.

About Release Schedule on PC Platforms Using Non-official Launchers

  • Steam

To bring the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature to Steam, we plan to release the official launcher on this platform in the future. When the Official Launcher becomes available on Steam, the platform will also support pre-download for the game. Please remember to update your launcher and experience the new features. These features are currently under active development and will be made available as soon as possible. We will notify you of the release schedule and detailed instructions on how to update the launcher in future announcements. Please stay tuned.

FAQ

Q: Are package tiers the same as in-game graphics settings?

A: No, they are different. The package tier determines the upper limit of the quality of the downloaded resources, such as image clarity and video bitrate, while in-game graphics settings remain adjustable. However, visual performance and resolution will vary from tier to tier even with the same graphics settings. For example, with the High Quality option enabled, the UHD package delivers higher image clarity and shows more details than the HD package.

Q: What are the differences between the various package tiers?

A: The package tiers vary in package size, video bitrate, and highest available resolution. For instance, the differences between the available tiers in Version 3.7 are as follows:

| | | | | | |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Platform | Package Tier | Size (excluding cutscenes) | Size (including cutscenes) | Recommended Resolution | Highest Available Graphics Quality |

| PC | UHD | 99G | 128G | 3840X2160 | Ultra Quality |

| HD | 80G | 97G | 2560X1440 | High Quality |

| SD | 58G | 70G | 1920X1080 | Balanced |

| iOS / Android | HD | 40G | 53G | / | High Quality |

| SD | 35G | 43G | / | Balanced |

Package sizes shown are estimates. Please refer to the actual sizes in Version 3.7.

Q: How do I know which package to choose?

A: If you have been included in the limited test, the recommended package will be marked on your device based on the device specifications. Alternatively, you can refer to the specs table listed in the "How to Choose a Package Tier" section.

Q: Can I download a tier higher than what is recommended?

A: Yes. The recommendation is made based on your device specifications. You are free to download any tier you prefer. However, downloading a tier higher than recommended will take up unnecessary storage space and could cause framerate fluctuations, device overheating, and other issues. Please adjust accordingly based on your experience.

Due to hardware limitations, only the SD package is available on certain iOS/Android devices, in order to ensure a stable, smooth gaming experience.

Q: How many packages can I install locally?

A: Up to 3 different package tiers can be installed locally at the same time on PC; there is no need to uninstall existing tiers before downloading new ones. Only 1 package tier can be installed locally at the same time on mobile devices, and every switch between packages requires downloading the difference between the packages.

Q: If I'm in the limited test, can I exit it and pre-download Version 3.7?

A: Unfortunately, once you enter the test during Version 3.6, you cannot exit it. You may select and download a suitable resource tier after the Version 3.7 update. Thank you for your support and understanding.

Q: Will my access to the pre-download option be affected if I'm not in the limited test?

A: No. If you're not in the limited test, you can pre-download as normal, but the HD package will be pre-downloaded by default. For more details, please refer to the "About Version 3.7 Pre-download" section above.

Q: Can I participate in the test if I'm not using the official launcher on PC?

A: The test is currently available only on PC devices using the official launcher. Access to this feature will be gradually opened to other PC platforms with non-official launchers once the test concludes. For details, please refer to the "About Release Schedule on PC Platforms Using Non-official Launchers" section.

Q: Will the resources of each tier change in the future?

A: The upcoming "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature is currently under continuous optimization. In the future, we may adjust the resources included in each tier based on in-game performance and player feedback. The adjusted resources may differ to some extent from those in the current test version. Announcements about adjustments in this regard will be made during the corresponding versions. Please stay tuned.

We will continue to refine the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature based on player feedback. If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, please access the in-game [Feedback] feature to submit your feedback. Thank you for your support and understanding.

Wuthering Waves Dev Team

entry.title: Wuthering Waves Version 3.7 Update Maintenance Notice
entry.content:
Dear Rovers,

To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 3.7: Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination.

During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]

✦Maintenance Time: 2026-09-30 04:00 - 2026-09-30 11:00 (UTC+8)

✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2

✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-09-30 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.

In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.

[How to Update]

Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.

  • PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."

  • Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.

  • iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.

  • Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.

  • PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update

  • XBOX Series X|S: Open the home screen > Select "My games & apps" > Go to "Manage Updates" to find Wuthering Waves > Update the game.

  • XBOX PC: Open the XBOX app > Select "My Library" > Select Wuthering Waves and open the Manage screen > Go to the Files tab and select Check for Update.

[Pre-download]

✦Pre-download Start Time: 2026-09-28 10:00 (UTC+8)

[Required Pre-download Storage Space]

PC: 46GB (Actual package size: 26GB)

Android/iOS: 20GB (Actual package size: 13GB)

Pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space. To ensure there is sufficient storage space for resource integration during the update maintenance, a certain amount of space must be reserved. If the reserved space is insufficient, the update maintenance will not be completed.

After the update maintenance is complete, the extra space used for the resources merging process will be automatically freed up.

[How to Pre-download]

PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.

Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.

You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.

Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.

[About the Schedule for the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" Limited Test]

✦Test Participants and Test Schedule

PC (※Official Launcher): The test will become available in stages on PC following the Version 3.7 update.

iOS/Android Mobile: The test will become available on all iOS/Android mobile devices following the Version 3.7 update.

Notes

  • We will soon (during Version 3.6) make a PC launcher update available to some of the Rovers who are granted access to the limited test. However, the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature will only go live after the Version 3.7 update. During Version 3.6, being granted access to the limited test will not affect your current gaming experience.

  • Following the Version 3.7 update, Rovers who have not been granted access to the limited test will have their resource package updated to the High-Definition (HD) version by default. Once you enter the test, you can adjust the resource tier based on your needs.

The feature will also be gradually made available on PC platforms with non-official launchers after the test concludes. Please stay tuned for future announcements.

✦Additional Notes on the Limited Test and Version 3.7 Pre-Download

PC (※Official Launcher):

  • For Rovers who are granted access to the limited test and update the official launcher during Version 3.6, Version 3.7 pre-download will be temporarily unavailable due to cross-version functionality differences. You may select and download a suitable resource tier after the Version 3.7 update.

  • For Rovers who do not gain access to the limited test during Version 3.6, pre-download will remain available, and if they use the pre-download feature, the High-Definition (HD) resource tier will be downloaded by default. After gaining test access in Version 3.7, you can then choose a resource tier based on your needs.

iOS/Android Mobile:

  • Once Version 3.7 pre-download becomes available, only a portion of the resources will be pre-downloaded on iOS and Android mobile devices. The remaining tiered resources will be downloaded separately after the Version 3.7 update, based on the package selected.

The Pre-download feature from Version 3.7 onward will function as usual, and the pre-downloaded resources will be of the same tier as your currently selected resources.

entry.title: Patch Notes for Version 3.6: Lamplight in Mirage, Sword's Resolve in Heart
entry.content:
Dear Rovers,

Thank you for your continued support. The following is a summary of content that will become available in Version 3.6: Lamplight in Mirage, Sword's Resolve in Heart.

Maintenance Time & Compensation Details

  • Maintenance Time: 2026-08-20 04:00 - 2026-08-20 11:00 (UTC+8)

  • Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2

  • Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-08-20 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.

In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.

  • Bug Fixes Compensation: Astrite x300

  • Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-08-20 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.

Version Update Details

New Resonators

5-Star Resonator: Qingxiao (Aero/Sword)

A reclusive sword cultivator who holds the nominal title of Xuan Paragon of Xuanfang Hold, and a peerless master of both qin and sword. Aloof and distant, she seems untouched by emotion.

The world knows her as the Sword Transcendent. For years beyond counting, she has stood guard over these lands, and the cold light of her blade remains as keen as the day she first drew it.

Combat Roles: Main Damage Dealer, Tune Strain Response

Obtainable through the [Wind of Transcendence] Featured Resonator Convene.

5-Star Resonator: Jingran (Fusion/Broadblade)

A Nethermancer from Mengzhou. An explorer wandering amid Mirage Realms and forgotten ruins. With his own eyes, he beholds the world's lingering echoes and the ancient traces it left behind.

He follows no sect and bows to no doctrine, heeding neither gods nor decrees. Through Mirage Realms and shadowed lands he walks, judging right from wrong by his own heart alone, and in doing so, he has forged a path entirely his own.

Combat Roles: Main Damage Dealer, Heavy Attack DMG

Obtainable through the [Where Santu Beckons] Featured Resonator Convene.

New Weapons

5-Star Weapon: Glint of Clouds (Sword)

Wreathed in mist and cloud, still waters blend with the sky in seamless blue. Sparse shadows slant across as a rain of petals falls.

May I bear this jade blade into the mortal realm, cleanse a tarnished age, and put the wicked to the sword.

Obtainable through the [Glint of Clouds] Featured Weapon Convene.

5-Star Weapon: Thousandfold Deliverance (Broadblade)

Endless stretches the Netherworld; the long night knows no end. Ten thousand souls lie hushed, and all sound fades to silence.

When cold, golden rays illuminate the Nether Gate, the sunken dreams of ages past shall at last be brought to light.

Obtainable through the [Thousandfold Deliverance] Featured Weapon Convene.

New Location

Xuanyuan Domain

Reach the location during Main Quest Chapter IV Act III "Song of the Heart Sword."

New Echo

Calamity Effigy

New Stories

[Main Quest] Chapter IV Act III: Song of the Heart Sword

With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City. At the same time, large-scale mechanism malfunctions seem to have begun spreading across the land.

  • Duration: Permanently available after the Version 3.6 update.

  • Eligibility: Complete Main Quest Chapter IV Segue "The Chant of Unseen Ties" to unlock.

[Main Quest] Chapter IV Segue: The Nethermancer's Requiem

Days after the crisis has been resolved, Liangyu brings you news of the Nethermancer's return. As agreed, you decide to meet him at Xianling Village. The old debts have been buried. Yet new storms gather at the horizon...

  • Duration: Permanently available after the Version 3.6 update.

  • Eligibility✦ Complete Main Quest Chapter IV Act III "Song of the Heart Sword."

New Events & Gameplay Features

Special Events

[Resonance Sim Realm] Combat Event

This is an open-ended test of ability diversity, a simulated experiment that keeps iterating under layer upon layer of interference. The Tethys System continuously supplies interference sources of every kind, free for participants to tap into and combine as they explore ever richer structures of ability. Every type of ability you bring online opens up new possibilities for the whole.

  • Duration: 2026-08-22 10:00 - 2026-09-29 11:59 (server time)

[Second Coming of Solaris: Coded Deception] Leisure Event

A brand-new version of Second Coming of Solaris like you've never seen is coming soon! What are you waiting for? Come give it a try!

  • Duration: 2026-08-27 04:00 - 2026-09-14 03:59 (server time)

[The Strings Remember] Leisure Event

With peace restored to the Land of Xuanfang, you once again return to the peak where Qingxiao lives. She gave you a seven-string qin some time ago. This time, she intends to formally teach you how to play it...

  • Duration: 2026-09-03 04:00 - 2026-09-21 03:59 (server time)

[If Dreams Still Reverberate] Featured Co-op Combat Event

The Ivory Gatekeeper has sent you an SOS over WavesLine! The gate in the depths of the Somnoire—the one that should never be opened, the one you once shut—has somehow come open again. Now, terrifying Nightmares are once again running rampant in the Somnoire...

  • Duration: 2026-09-10 10:00 - 2026-09-29 03:59 (server time)

[Wuthering Exploration] Featured Exploration Event: Fogveil Pagoda

Pioneer Association picked the Fogveil Pagoda as the new theme for Wutherium Geographic magazine.

  • Duration: 2026-09-17 04:00 - 2026-09-29 03:59 (server time)

[Gifts of Drifting Mist] 7-Day Login Event

During the event, log in to claim the day's login rewards from the event page.

  • Duration: Version 3.6 Update - 2026-09-29 03:59 (server time)

New Merch

Accessories: Qingxiao - Cloudbloom, Jingran - Snowpaw

New Challenge

New "Tactical Hologram: Sparring" Challenge: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis

Other New Content

Motorbike Liveries: Cloud Voyage, Jadie the Mightiest Autopuppet

Title: Resonance! Best Combo

Phantom Echo: Phantom - Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis

Title: Resonance! Best Combo and Phantom - Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis can be obtained by participating in the combat event "Resonance Sim Realm."

Adjustments and Optimizations

Features

Expedition Motorbike

New feature: Display Theme

  • Go to Expedition Motorbike > Motorbike Appearance to view and switch between Display Themes.

  • Complete Main Quest "Beneath a Melting Night Sky" to claim the Display Theme "Startorch Academy Garage" in the Startorch Academy chat window on WavesLine.

  • Complete Main Quest "Song of the Heart Sword" to claim the Display Theme "Cloud Ride Garage" in the Xuanfang Ministry of Development chat window on WavesLine.

If you complete the necessary Main Quest, you can claim the corresponding Display Theme via WavesLine.

Better Autopilot Mode Experience

  • In Autopilot Mode, if the motorbike remains stationary for a certain period of time, the system will automatically reset its position and attempt to resume Autopilot.

  • When the destination is close, the system will now recommend traveling there directly instead of activating Navigation Tracking.

  • Resolved misalignment issues of some icons in Autopilot Mode.

Better Motorbike Performance in Certain Situations

  • When the motorbike's path is blocked by certain small objects in Mengzhou's Land of Xuanfang, the objects will become transparent, and the motorbike will be able to drive on.

Sharing

Extended Sharing Function to More In-game Content Across Platforms

  • Images in the Gallery's Sceneries and Main Story sections.

  • The result screen at the conclusion of each Endstate Matrix challenge, and the screen displaying the total points before you restart an Endstate Matrix challenge.

  • Whimpering Wastes challenge results.

  • Tower of Adversity challenge results.

Adjusted Sharing Function for Convene Screen on Mobile

  • When you obtain a 5-Star Resonator via a 10-pull attempt, you can access a sharable page of the Resonator.

  • When you obtain a 5-Star Weapon via a 10-pull attempt, you can access a sharable page of the Weapon.

Mail

New Feature: Mail Favorites

  • Added the Favorites button at the bottom of a Mail. Use it to favorite the Mail.

  • Favorited Mails will not be deleted when their expiration dates come up or when you select "Delete Read Mails."

  • You can favorite up to 100 mails.

Please note that unfavoriting favorited mails at a date later than their expiration dates will result in their deletion.

Adjusted Mail Function

  • The mailbox can now store a maximum of 200 mails.

  • Increased the number of attachments that can be included in a single mail to 40.

  • Adjusted the logic governing which mails will be auto-deleted first when the limit is reached.

Make sure to claim your attachments promptly to avoid any loss from expiration and deletion.

Echo Recommendation

Optimized Echo Recommendation

  • Go to a Resonator's Echo page and click on the Suggest button to access the upgraded Echo recommendation page.

  • The new system will provide more precise and personalized Echo recommendations. After selecting a Sonata Effect, you can press the Preview button to view a comparison between the currently equipped plan and the recommended plan, and then choose to apply the recommended plan.

  • A "Main Echo" slot will be added to the "Suggest" feature on the Echo equipment menu; select it to filter the Echoes.

The Echo Recommendation data are scheduled to be updated on 2026-08-26 to those based on recently active players. Please note that following the update, the Echoes recommended in the new version may differ from those recommended in previous versions.

Leveling

  • Adjusted the range of effective Echo absorption in certain domains.

Challenges, Puzzles, & Events

  • Optimized certain gameplay features involving Grapple in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou" area.

Quests

Optimized the quest flow of the Suisui line in the Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm."

Controls

  • Added haptic feedback through controller vibration while accelerating during Flight.

UI

Endstate Matrix

Optimized Display of Certain Endstate Matrix Pages

  • Added the Weapon Projection Preview option for Weapon Projections on the Rewards screen in Endstate Matrix.

  • Refined the special effects and visual details of the Medal screen in Endstate Matrix.

  • Adjusted the mechanics of how the red dot attached to the Weekly Activity tab is displayed; to remove it, you need to enter any Weekly Activity.

  • Adjusted the design of the skip button in the top left corner of the screen to prevent overlapping with song lyrics.

  • Adjusted the display of quest items to support multi-page display of items that have multiple copies.

  • Optimized the display of certain icons.

Graphics & Performance

Graphics Settings

Upgraded NVIDIA DLSS Support to DLSS 4.5.

  • You can enable the 5x or 6x options in DLSS 4.5 frame generation, if your device meets the following requirements:

  1. RTX 50 Series

  2. With DX12 enabled (first enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling in your system's graphics settings)

  3. Graphics driver version is 595.97 or newer.

  • If your device meets the requirements, you can select the 5x or 6x options in DLSS 4.5 via Settings > Graphics > Advanced > Frame Generation. You can choose your frame generation rate based on your needs or the configuration of your device.

If the original frame rate is too low, enabling Frame Generation can increase the frame rate. Please note that enabling this option may cause input lag or display issues.

Extended Availability of Vulkan on Mobile

  • Following the Version 3.6 update maintenance, the Vulkan option can also be enabled in the following processors:

  1. Snapdragon 8 Gen 2

  2. Dimensity 9200, 9200+

  3. XRing O1

  • This option is accessible via Settings > Graphics > Vulkan. Please restart the game after enabling the Vulkan option for the change to take effect.

  • Enabling the Vulkan option improves the game's performance and power consumption while it is being run on mobile.

Following the version update, the Vulkan option will now be on by default on mobile devices equipped with Snapdragon 8 Elite, Snapdragon 8 Elite 2, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, or Dimensity 9500.

  • Extended support for Ray Tracing Megalights to devices equipped with AMD graphics. On devices equipped with AMD graphics that meet the requirements, enabling Ray Tracing improves the lighting effects in certain environments. (※There isn't a separate "Megalights" option. It takes effect when Ray Tracing is enabled.)

  • Extended support for self-developed frame generation to mobile devices equipped with Snapdragon 8 Gen 5. If your processor meets the requirements, you can enable this option via Settings > Graphics > Frame Generation.

Audio

  • Added a tag and timer to some tracks/albums that are available for a limited time. The timer shows how much time a track/album will remain available.

  • Adjusted certain audio files to prevent abnormal triggering.

  • Optimized some audio/stereo effects.

Other

Performance Optimization (At Testing Stage)

"New Programming Language" Cross-Platform Performance Optimization

  • Following the version 3.6 update maintenance, a new performance optimization involving a change of programming language will be introduced; this optimization will be rolled out in stages across all platforms in the form of online testing.

  • With this optimization, on devices that meet the requirements across all platforms, the game's overall performance and average frame rate will improve to a certain extent.

  • This optimization is currently unavailable on the following devices:

  1. iOS mobile devices with RAM≤4GB; iPhone 14 series with iOS 16.0/17.0/17.1/17.2.

  2. Android mobile devices with RAM≤6GB.

The testing schedule may be subject to changes due to version stability or other considerations. Please refer to the notice titled [Version 3.6 Known Issues & Updates] for details about the schedule.

This optimization is at the testing stage and is not the final version.

  • Adjusted the maximum number of Radiant Tides or Forging Tides allowed in a single exchange attempt in the Afterglow Coral Store (under Item Exchange). When you try to obtain more than 10 Radiant Tides or Forging Tides in a single exchange attempt, a confirmation box, showing the number of Tides and the cost, will appear.

  • Optimized the descriptions of certain in-game settings and functions.

Bug Fixes

Resonators & Weapons

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Suisui's character model might behave abnormally with Wounded Effect enabled.

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Suisui's character model might behave abnormally when performing Plunging Attack while in Drizzle Stance.

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Yangyang: Xuanling's character model might behave abnormally.

  • Fixed an issue where damage and some effects associated with Rover: Electro's Resonance Skill "Thrum of All Sounds" remained effective after the skill was interrupted.

  • Fixed an issue where enemy names might appear on the Protocol Interface when Resonator Lucy cast Resonance Liberation "Netrunner."

  • Fixed an issue where skill icons did not appear when switching to controller mode when the Protocol Interface was displayed after Resonator Lucy cast Resonance Liberation "Netrunner."

  • Corrected textual errors in Resonator Rebecca's Character Stories.

  • Fixed a display issue with the special effects of certain equipped weapons on Resonator Hiyuki's Weapon Switch page (Resonators > Weapon > Weapon Switch).

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Aemeath's character model might behave abnormally while walking in certain scenes.

  • Fixed an issue where Resonator Lynae's character model on the Resonators page might behave abnormally.

  • Fixed an issue in the fight with the enemy "Scar" where certain attacks from Rover: Spectro might cause Scar's hit-taking VFX to appear abnormal.

  • Fixed a display issue with metal textures on some Resonators' Outfits.

Features

  • Fixed an issue where completing Weekly Challenge's Bell of Archaic Chants challenge did not count toward the "Complete Weekly Challenge 2 times" task in Pioneer Podcast.

  • Fixed an issue with the animation that plays upon switching to a different Resonator in Resonator Showcase.

  • Fixed an issue in Resonator Ascension Planner where it was not possible to jump to the Convene pages of the recommended weapons by pressing the corresponding icons.

  • Fixed an issue where the screen might become unresponsive when trying to call up the location on the map where a certain Material could be found via the Resonators - Forte screen.

  • Fixed an issue where it was not possible to jump to other pages from the Resonators screen.

  • Fixed an issue where the screen might become unresponsive when trying to open the Mingshen Notices page.

  • Fixed an issue where purchasing and applying Chassis Sets might cause an error message to appear. This issue did not affect the actual ownership of the purchased items.

  • Fixed an issue in Tactical Hologram: Sparring - Denia where the model of the enemy Denia might behave abnormally.

  • Fixed an issue where the Resonance Mode Switch icon might appear on the Team screen when no Resonators were selected.

  • Fixed an issue where changing the lineup of the current team might cause the screen to become unresponsive.

  • Fixed an issue where switching between Weapon Projections on the Weapon Projection screen might not take effect.

  • Corrected textual errors in the description of the Sonata Effect "Frosty Resolve" (5pcs) on the Sonata Gallery screen. This did not affect the actual effects of the Sonata Effect.

  • Fixed a display issue with the models of the enemies "Voidworm" and "Abyssal Gladius" in the Enemies section of the Gallery.

  • Fixed an issue where players might be led to the locations of defeated enemies when tracking certain enemies via Enemy Tracing.

  • Fixed an issue where switching between male Rover and female Rover could cause multiple tabs to appear for Rover: Electro in Skill Training/Resonator Skill Tutorial.

  • Fixed an issue where certain player actions could cause text from the previous screen to stay on the Overworld screen upon returning to the Overworld.

  • Fixed an error with the skill configurations for some skills of Trial Resonators at different levels.

  • Fixed an issue on PC where the frame generation function might not work.

  • Fixed a display issue with certain options in the Xess3 settings in certain languages.

  • Fixed an issue where the Trophy "Only Reverberation Remains" could not be obtained in some situations.

Challenges, Puzzles, & Events

Fixed an issue in the "Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis" event where the stat boost "Movement Speed +100%" for the selected Resonator "Mornye" might not take effect.

  • Fixed an issue in the "Into the Land of Paradox's Restoration - Solisia Landing" event where an incorrect number of collectables was displayed for Treasure Spots. This issue did not affect the actual number of collectables.

  • Fixed an issue in the "Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways" event where conducting Resonance Conversion for Rover could cause the weapon model on Rover's Weapon page to display abnormally.

  • Fixed a display issue with the text on the Cube Lineup screen in the "Cube, Cubic n Cubie" event.

  • Fixed an issue in controller mode where certain player actions could cause the screen to become unresponsive while displaying Whimpering Wastes-related pages.

  • Fixed an issue where the background music continued to play after completing certain Super Cloud Ride Challenges.

  • Fixed an issue where the prompt "You've entered a speed-limit zone. Boost Unavailable" might appear while in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou" area when the expedition motorbike was not being used.

  • Fixed an issue where certain skills of some characters could not destroy the suspension bridge during the quest objective "The suspension bridge is quite old, perhaps you could..."

  • Fixed an issue in some Forgery Challenges where successful attempts at using Negative Status to defeat enemies were not counted toward the total.

  • Fixed an issue where using Levitator to interact with specific objects that supposedly responded to Levitator was not possible in some situations.

  • Fixed an issue where certain player actions could cause Resonators to fall outside the bounds of the Map when trying to enter certain Tacet Fields.

  • Fixed an issue where the corresponding task in Milestones remained marked as uncompleted upon completing the "Tactical Hologram: Calamity - Impermanence Heron" challenge.

Quests

  • Fixed an issue on Mac where character models or the background might become blurry during certain dialogue scenes in the Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm."

  • Fixed an issue in animated storytelling during certain Main Quests where input prompts overlapped with subtitles in certain settings.

  • Fixed an issue that prevented quest progression in the Main Quest "When the Unknown Thrums" where some Rovers were prevented from returning to Chronorift Metropolis.

  • Fixed an issue where Rover's character model might behave abnormally during certain dialogue scenes.

  • Fixed an issue in the Exploration Quest "Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall" where dialogue scenes might be disrupted during the objective "Defeat Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis."

  • Fixed an issue in the Exploration Quest "Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall" where Danjin's character model might behave abnormally in the Ride Share sequence during the objective "Read Suyu's WavesLine message."

  • Fixed an issue where the weather in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou - Western Fang Peaks" area was constantly Cloudy after completing the Exploration Quest "Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall."

  • Fixed an issue in the Exploration Quest "Autopuppets in Fog Veiled Chambers" where restarting the game could prevent players from returning to the task location.

  • Fixed an anomaly with NPC Liangyu's eye blinking effect.

Environment

  • Fixed an issue where the screen might flicker when displaying the "Huanglong - Mengzhou" area with Ray Tracing enabled.

  • Fixed an issue where certain water surfaces flickered in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou - Southern Yuan Hills" area.

  • Fixed an issue on mobile where the colors of the vegetation in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou" area displayed abnormally.

  • Fixed an issue where certain player actions could cause black lines to appear on the screen while displaying the "Huanglong - Mengzhou - Xuanfang Hold" area.

  • Fixed a clipping issue with certain objects in the environment in the "Huanglong - Mengzhou" area.

  • Fixed an issue where certain player actions could cause the lighting effects in the "Fogveil Pagoda - Hunting Chamber" area to display abnormally.

  • Fixed an issue where the character model floated above the surface while seated on chairs in the "Rinascita - Septimont" area.

  • Fixed an anomaly with the animation effects for certain objects in the "Rinascita - Septimont" area.

entry.title: V3.6 Wuthering Waves Battle Rush
entry.content:
Dear Rovers,

The Wuthering Waves Battle Rush is now live! Record and share your most exciting battle moments with the hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle on X (Twitter)/YouTube Shorts/TikTok to compete for a reward of Astrite x2,000 and a chance to get featured on our social media with direct credits! Other than these rewards, 10 extra winners will be selected to receive a $50 Amazon Gift Card.

Showcase your outstanding battle tactics in a condensed clip and share them with us!

Content Requirement

Create your own combat video featuring Wuthering Waves.

We require no limits to the characters, level, or scenes. All entries that feature your combat in Wuthering Waves are qualified to join the event and compete for rewards!

Content Requirement

Create your own combat video featuring Wuthering Waves.

We require no limits to the characters, level, or scenes. All entries that feature your combat in Wuthering Waves are qualified to join the event and compete for rewards!

How to Submit

Post your work on X (Twitter)/YouTube Shorts/TikTok with both hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle included publicly.

Submission Period

2026/08/20 20:00 ~ 2026/09/17 19:59 (PT)

Judging Criteria

All eligible works will undergo evaluation based on their adherence to the theme, degree of completion, reception among players, and other relevant factors.

Notes

To qualify for participation, you should include both hashtags #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle in your post.

Deleted posts will not be qualified for entitlement of rewards.

You can submit multiple entries. However, the same work published on different platforms will not count towards the rewards.

Entries listed below may be excluded from the judging process:

  • Works not created in accordance with Wuthering Waves

  • Works found to contain plagiarism or infringement of intellectual property rights

  • Works submitted outside the event period

  • Works created with the assistance of AI technology

  • Works featuring extremely aggressive content, including but not limited to themes of pornography, violence, politics, or racism

  • Works that have already been used for commercial purposes

  • Works deemed inappropriate by the judges

Failure to reply to the official staff within 7 days from the date of notification will be considered a waiver of entitlement to the rewards.

This event is open to submissions from all languages, as creators proficient in any language are eligible to compete for rewards. Entries differing only in language will be treated as equivalent works.
